title: k1llall and godall
script:
-- https://discord.gg/eTHyrcqXcA


local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local event = lp.Character:WaitForChild("Secondary").bulletHole

while true do
    for _, p in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
        local char = p.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        if p ~= lp and hum and hum.Health > 0 and hrp then
            event:FireServer(hum, math.huge, hrp.Position) -- if you put -math.huge everyone gets inf life lol
            hum.Health = 0
        end
    end
    task.wait(0.05)
end
